versions.content: When the function Spi_AsyncTransmit is called and the re- quested Sequence shares Jobs with another sequence that is in the state SPI_SEQ_PENDING, the SPI Handler/Driver shall not take into account this new re- quest and this function shall return the value E_NOT_OK. In this case and according to [SWS_BSW_00042] and [SWS_BSW_00045], the SPI Handler/Driver shall report the SPI_E_SEQ_PENDING error.
